projectDescription: Open-source RWA tokenization infrastructure for African markets — a TypeScript SDK, CLI, and smart contract suite that lets developers tokenize real-world assets (farmland, commodities, real estate, invoices, carbon credits, mining rights) on EVM chains and Stellar without writing Solidity.
keyFeatures: Six pre-audited asset class templates: Farmland, Commodity, Real Estate, Invoice, Carbon Credit, Mining Rights
Deploy tokens via CLI wizard or TypeScript SDK with no Solidity required
Multi-chain support: Polygon, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Celo, and Stellar (Soroban)
Milestone-based escrow contract for tranche payments
Fiat on-ramp / off-ramp integration with pluggable provider interface (MoonPay, Stellar Anchor, Manual)
Collateral vault for asset-backed lending on Stellar
React hooks for wallet balances and asset metadata in browser apps
MCP server for AI-assisted token deployment via Claude and other LLMs
Event indexer with webhook delivery for on-chain contract events
Pluggable KYC interface (IIdentityVerifier) supporting Smile Identity, Persona, and custom providers
publicApiSurface: TokenFactory — deployFarmland(), deployCommodity(), deployRealEstate(), deployInvoice(), deployCarbonCredit(), deployMiningRights()
EscrowManager — fund(), markDelivered(), approveMilestone(), dispute(), resolve(), refund()
CLI — ankara init, ankara deploy-factory, ankara deploy, ankara mint, ankara status
CLI — ankara deploy-escrow, ankara escrow-fund, ankara escrow-deliver, ankara escrow-approve
CLI — ankara onramp-initiate, ankara offramp-initiate, ankara ramp-quote, ankara ramp-status
CLI — ankara deploy-nft, ankara batch-mint, ankara register-batch
MCP tools — deploy_token, get_token_status, deploy_escrow, fund_milestone, release_milestone
